scenarios.name: Substation Alpha unavailable
scenarios.description: Planning exercise: the fictional primary distribution source is unavailable. Backup assets remain available unless a declared dependency says otherwise.
review_actions: Confirm generator fuel autonomy and start conditions with facility owners.
Review the East Corridor signal and clinic contingency evidence.
Resolve the proposed shelter and archive relationships before readiness reporting.

scenarios.name: East water pumping loses utility and backup power
scenarios.description: Planning exercise: Substation Alpha and the shared water backup generator are unavailable simultaneously.
review_actions: Validate alternative water supply, storage duration, and transfer arrangements.
Confirm which health and shelter services have tested water contingencies.

scenarios.name: Regional communications outage
scenarios.description: Planning exercise: both fictional telecom exchanges are unavailable; the independently modeled emergency radio network remains available.
review_actions: Confirm radio coverage, user access, and exercise evidence for emergency coordination.
Review services with a single fiber-dependent channel.
